name: zamua
description: Zamua's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram forum-topic agent router: multiplex one bot token across concurrent Claude Code conversations, plus opt-in harness-locked Google Antigravity topics in persistent Herdr sessions with dynamic subscription model and effort selection.

plugins.name: pr-review-board
plugins.description: React to a pull request with an emoji and a background Claude reviews it: a local poller spawns one review agent per changeset in its own herdr workspace, which writes the review to a board drawn beside it in the board plugin's review view, a plain-English report linked to the code it calls out and the numbered comments it proposes. It posts only the ones you pick. Approves only when you say so, never pushes.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: One pane beside the chat holding every board, with a row of buttons to switch between them: the session board Claude keeps current, the pull requests this session raised with GitHub's live state, the pr-review-board review this session runs, one tree of everything you work on from your goals down to the sessions and pull requests doing it, where a root session starts and coordinates the others, and any board another process writes as JSON, such as a rollout, named in ~/.config/board/boards.json. Each button shows how many items wait on you. /board toggles the pane, /board <name> opens it on one board.

plugins.name: clean-code-audit
plugins.description: Check code against eleven smells: implicit coupling, layer-first folders, duplication, representable illegal states, god files, shotgun surgery, layering violations, pass-through wrappers, validation not at the boundary, change-detector tests, and implicit state machines. A guide while implementing, a checklist for self-reviewing a diff, and a method for auditing a repo with path:line evidence and a complete, severity-ordered list of fixes.
